_rule: Prepared BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). STAGED, not queued, not authorized. One Water Queens House (S8) launch, Ultra with fg=3, the RTX Hair On bundle of 6k exactly as the launcher writes it (rt_hair_header_cam_gpu, rt_hair_header_scene_pass and rt_hair_coverage_keep inside it), detailed logging, nothing else: no card fill, no dense sampler (both are compiled into the strand pipelines and are not what ships). Only rt_hair_coverage_keep is toggled inside the run (its A/B).

changed_since: 6k (branch claude/hair-cleanup): rt_hair_coverage_keep is in the bundle; with it an entering head arms the prepass in the frame its groom is first published (SwapGate::early); rt_hair_stale_publish, rt_hair_row_stable, rt_hair_watchdog_draw, rt_hair_watchdog_one_key, rt_hair_swap_latch and rt_hair_coverage_min_pixels are removed with their code. The switches line lost 'key watchdog', 'coverage latched', 'key watchdog trips' and 'latched keys'; the 'stale publish check' line is gone; the first hitch frame of a session is logged once without detailed logging ('[hair primary] hitch frame').
observable: (1) The new bundle keeps the strands in every frame of the wheel dolly and the orbit: 0 switches to cards of any cause, as in-keep and out-keep of 194658. (2) A head that enters the view shows its cards for 3 or 4 frames instead of 5 (10 with rt_hair_coverage_keep off, measured in the same run). (3) The removals changed nothing: header, watchdog, dropout and rebase lines as in 194658.
windows: warmup 20 s, warm-ab 3 s (keep 0), warm-on 3 s; pre-in, pre-out (120 frames, wheel +10 / -10, unjudged: the near LODs upload); bundle: settle-on, in-on, out-on (180 frames, wheel), orbit-r, orbit-l (180 frames, 60 px/s from the first second); keep off: settle-nokeep, in-nokeep, out-nokeep (180 frames, wheel); bundle again: settle-on2, in-on2, out-on2 (180 frames, wheel). About 100 s of phases.

part1_bundle.keys: the RTX Hair On bundle of common/settings.h, nothing else
part1_bundle.gated: in-on, out-on, orbit-r, orbit-l, in-on2, out-on2. Header pass line: 'applied at the scene G-buffer pass N', 'at the decal pass 0', 'label taken by the decal pass 0', 'by another scene pass 0'. Switches line: ' 0 strands->cards' with frame watchdog 0, coverage low 0, coverage high 0, coverage stale/none/invalidated 0, header not applied 0, live toggle 0, other 0; 0 frames with every draw on cards; frame watchdog trips 0. Rebase origin 0 in every sampled frame. These are counts of real faults: 0, no tolerance.
part1_bundle.predicted_not_gated: cards->strands 2-3 per dolly (heads that enter the view), 0-2 per orbit. Card runs: median 3 or 4 frames, never above 5 (194658 with keep: 5). 3 when the header the arriving frame applied already holds the groom, 4 when it does not; both are the change working. Frame line: G-buffer refusals 'coverage stale' 0, 'strike' 2-3 per entering head, 'card depth not dropped' 0-1 per entering head (194658: 3 and 2). Main G-buffer strand draws 98.5% or more of the hair draws (194658 keep: 99.4-99.5%). Dropouts: only 'no card marker' at 0 pixels. Strand G-buffer draws 0.13-0.20 ms zoomed out, 0.27-0.35 ms near.
part1_bundle.if_it_fails: a switch to cards with 'coverage low' right after a cards->strands switch of the same key: a kept verdict was wrong for a head that came back (the confirm rule then needs 2 bad measurements: 5-6 frames of thin strands); report the key's ratios and take rt_hair_coverage_keep out of the bundle. 'prepass card depth dropped without its G-buffer swap' above 0 or a rise of the fallback count with holes: the early prepass met a G-buffer without a fallback; turn the key off (it restores both waits). Card runs of 5: the early mark did not fire (the arriving frame's header never held the groom and the ready mark was not seen by the next prepass); no fault, the change is then without effect: say so.

part2_keep_off.keys: the bundle with rt_hair_coverage_keep=0 (the state qualified in 194658's in-on and out-on; the handshake change is off with it)
part2_keep_off.predicted: in-nokeep, out-nokeep: header gates as part 1; frame watchdog 0, coverage low 0, coverage high 0, 0 frames on cards. 'coverage stale/none/invalidated' 0 or 1 (a draw off the screen for 28 frames). Card runs of 10 frames; 16-35 'coverage stale' G-buffer refusals per window.

hitch_frames: '[hair primary] hitch frame' is expected in no window (0 seen in 190905 and 194658). If the line appears it reads 'it applied its own strand header and tag'; the windows after it must still pass part 1. That would be the first live proof of the 6i per-recording header.
not_gated: card runs, cards->strands counts, refusal counts, dropout counts, GPU ms and the keep-off window's stale switches are reported. The window may be occluded: no frame time is judged.
dropped_since_194658: the card fill windows and PNG pairs (decided: an Advanced option, 6j), the dense sampler (qualified in two runs; a diagnostic pipeline variant), the control without rt_hair_header_scene_pass (reproduced in 190905 and 194658).
target: strands in every frame of a converted style, also under fast camera motion, with no card/strand flipping, and a head that enters the view on strands within 3-4 frames. A style or LOD without a groom file keeps its cards (S8: 2 draws a frame, index counts 3399 and 7086).
